published_prior_art.cite: Conditional Jensen contraction for conditional expectation; standard Hilbert-space fact.
Hilbert-space projection theorem; AiChen2007MisspecifiedConditionalMoments motivates pseudo-true centering but does not make this projection lemma novel.
DikkalaLewisMackeySyrgkanis2020Minimax uses bounded symmetric/star-convex adversarial classes, but does not state this particular split-path construction.

repo_prior_art.cite: API §3 and stat_npiv_nosol_modulus/source_representer_minimax concern other NPIV targets; neither contains a split-selected implicit-TRAE oracle inequality with a separate restricted-witness deficiency.

published_prior_art.cite: TanSyrgkanis2026Adaptive gives exact-witness discrepancy-selected TRAE; LiLanSyrgkanisWangUehara2024RegularizedDeepIV gives misspecified explicit-operator RDIV selection. Neither verified source states the proposed jointly selected implicit-critic bound.
TanSyrgkanis2026Adaptive, Theorem 3.13, is the exact-specification saturated-rate benchmark; this is only a conditional calibration of the new selector.
LiLanSyrgkanisWangUehara2024RegularizedDeepIV, Theorem 12, has target and learned-operator errors but not this elementary restricted-critic construction.
No verified cited result supplies a lower bound for a split TRAE selector with an adversarial witness class that annihilates a residual block.

soundness_flags.label: lem:well-defined-path and def:trae-path
soundness_flags.one_line: Pointwise measurability of the displayed suprema does not provide a jointly measurable choice of the data-dependent n^{-1}-approximate minimizer, so \widehat h and its validation score are not yet defined as measurable random objects.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: conj:validated-misspecified-trae / ass:pseudotrue-attainment
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Existence of the minimum-norm least-squares pseudo-true projection is assumed for the misspecified branch.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The oracle inequality is conditional on attained pseudo-true projection and targets h^\dagger; its causal h_0 interpretation is only under valid IV and completeness.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: prop:zero-defect-calibration / ass:grid-coverage
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Recovery of the exact-branch benchmark assumes the finite grid reaches the continuous oracle scale and that the holdout scale is no larger than the training stochastic scale.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The saturated exact-branch calibration is conditional on these grid and scale premises, not an unconditional reproduction of Tan--Syrgkanis.

source_verification_receipts.locator: §3.2, Assumptions 3.9--3.11, Proposition 3.12, Theorem 3.13, and Appendix B proof
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives discrepancy-principle TRAE analysis under its stated witness/richness and source conditions, proves termination, and derives adaptive strong/weak guarantees; its result is not a split-validation oracle inequality over misspecified target--witness pairs.

Theorem 12 treats misspecified RDIV through target-class and learned conditional-density/operator errors; Algorithm 2 and Theorem 13 use a separate validation set and regularized explicit-operator loss for model selection.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 2--5, setup, critical-radius definition, and main-theorem introduction
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies regularized minimax conditional-moment estimation with bounded symmetric/star-convex test classes, witness richness, and localized-Rademacher critical radii.
The paper develops source-condition double-robust inference and novel guarantees for iterated Tikhonov regularized adversarial estimators over general hypothesis spaces.

The article studies possibly misspecified semiparametric conditional moments and establishes convergence to pseudo-true values under low-level sufficient conditions; it supports the broad centering comparison, not a claimed formula-level equivalence.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make every training-path output a measurable object: impose a countable/separable parameterization with a measurable approximate-argmin rule, or define the estimator as the output of a specified measurable optimization algorithm and prove its n^{-1} suboptimality.

Add a formal reduction from the Gaussian diagonal experiment to the source-condition NPIV class, explicitly relating a, s, and beta; otherwise frame the Assouad question as a selector-class lower bound only, not evidence of sharpness for the headline oracle inequality.
State a weak-metric exact-branch corollary separately and compare its rate explicitly with Tan--Syrgkanis, rather than leaving the weaker generic weak display to imply the benchmark informally.

recommended_next_step: Revise the estimator definition to guarantee measurable approximate minimizers, then rerun review; the central misspecified implicit-TRAE oracle kernel remains a plausible field-tier contribution.
